name: Pixel Z [UPDATE]
desc:
Heres our new code: 15KOMG

Pick your fighter and battle in fast, pixel-art 2D combat! Chain combos, charge your ki, transform mid-fight and finish with a cinematic Ultimate.

KEYBOARD CONTROLS
Move / Jump: W A S D
Light: U
Medium: I
Heavy: O
Special: J
Ultimate: K
Guard: L
Dash: Space
Charge Ki: H
Dragon Rush: E
Transform: T
Pause: P

• 40+ fighters to unlock
• Fight the CPU or climb the ELO ranks online
• Top the global ELO and Wins leaderboards
• Open booster packs to find new fighters
• New? The built-in tutorial teaches you everything

Special moves: hold a direction + J, or Q + J
Full move list: Pause > List of Movements

Also playable on phone, tablet and controller!

Press PLAY and prove you're the strongest!

llm.loop: pick a fighter -> fight 2D pixel-art matches with combos, ki and transformations -> win to climb ELO -> open booster packs to unlock fighters
llm.objectives: climb the ELO and wins leaderboards and unlock fighters
llm.progression: ELO rank, wins, 40+ unlockable fighters via booster packs
llm.instructions: pick a fighter, chain combos, charge ki, transform and finish with an Ultimate; fight CPU or ranked online; tutorial included
unique: full 2D sprite fighting game with fighting-game controls inside Roblox
llm.thumbnails: pixel-art Dragon Ball-style characters: Goku with dragon balls, Super Saiyan transformation, Vegeta with scouter
llm.complexity_notes: custom 2D fighting engine, 40+ sprite-animated fighters, move lists, ELO matchmaking
